overall_disposition: Implementation-only approval may be requested after findings are carried into the Plan. Exact registration and launch remain held until remediations, tests, a superseding security review, final plan review, and a separate exact-artifact approval pass.
auth_root_threat_note: A local HMAC key cannot authenticate against malicious same-UID mutation. The revised Plan must require either an externally verifiable detached signature or explicit final-approval acceptance of a documented AUTH_ROOT residual limited to malicious same-UID/root compromise; accidental same-UID mutation remains in scope for locks and hash binding.
review_actions: Read-only. No files, queue state, processes, or external systems were modified by the security reviewer.
supersession: Any revised design requires an additive superseding security receipt before final Plan readiness review.
